run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum subarray XOR value for a given array and size n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in parameter sets to verify correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a trie-based approach instead of the brute force O(n squared) method
review_f_gold: review f_gold which computes the maximum XOR of all contiguous subarrays using nested loops
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that takes an array and n and returns the maximum subarray XOR found
